subject: IoTech renewal & expansion — volume bands and blended-rate proposal
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Susan Lewis <susan.lewis@iotech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: IoTech renewal & expansion — volume bands and blended-rate proposal

Hi Susan — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned before Marissa and I put a formal quote together.

Recap from call (high level):
- Current: IoTech production usage ~45M tokens/month across chat + embeddings (mostly chat during peak hours).
- Growth signal: product roadmap suggests a 3x uplift over the next 12 months with seasonal peaks. Forecasts you shared: 50M -> 120M -> 200M (month-by-month step increases tied to feature launches).
- Key asks from your side: target blended unit economics in the $750–$900 per 1M tokens range, and a solution that supports an additional low-latency route for edge models during peaks.
- Procurement timeline: procurement wants a commercial at or before July 8 to align with budget review; legal/PO expected in July.

What we’ll deliver next:
1) A short blended-rate proposal that models a 12-month step-up (baseline commitment + month-based step bands).
2) A note on routing options (hosted vs. reserved/dedicated pools) so you can weigh budget vs. latency.
3) A redlined SOW + MA/PO template for procurement to kick off legal review.

Attachments: iot_customer_usage.csv (you provided), we’ll attach our blended-pricing draft in the next email.

Question for you before we finalize pricing: is the $750–$900/1M your absolute ceiling, or is there flexibility if we can guarantee a 12-month stepped commit?

Propose a 30-minute follow-up call next Tue (6/29) to walk the blended numbers with Marissa (she’s leading the commercial). Availability: 9–11am PT or 2–4pm PT.

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0167

Karthik — thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers:
- The $750–$900/1M is our target band; $900 is an upper limit but we'd prefer closer to $800 if possible.
- The peak/edge route requirement is real — we need <120ms p95 for the customer-facing inference path; we’re open to dedicated capacity for that route if your blended economics hold up.
- Procurement timeline is correct: commercial by 7/8, PO mid-July if terms are acceptable.

I’ll block time for Tue 6/29 at 9:30am PT if that works for Marissa.

Thanks,
Susan
Head of Product Integrations | IoTech
susan.lewis@iotech.com

Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: IoTech renewal & expansion — volume bands and blended-rate proposal

Karthik / Ben — I sketched three commercial pathways below to hit Susan’s unit-econ target while protecting Redwood’s capacity. These are draft figures — will validate with finance and ops, then package as a PDF for IoTech.

Option A — Conservative commitment (lower discount, faster step-ups):
- Band 1 (0–50M/mo): $1,100 per 1M tokens
- Band 2 (50–150M/mo): $750 per 1M tokens
- Band 3 (150M+): $480 per 1M tokens
- Effective blended at 120M: ~$760 per 1M (with 3-month step-up schedule)
- Notes: No dedicated pool required; might not meet p95 <120ms during peak bursts.

Option B — 12-month stepped commit (preferred for customer economics):
- Band 1 (0–50M): $1,000 per 1M
- Band 2 (50–200M): $700 per 1M
- Band 3 (200M+): $450 per 1M
- Effective blended at 150M: ~$700 per 1M with guaranteed month-by-month step increases and 12-month revenue commitment.
- Notes: We can include a dedicated low-latency route for peak windows at a fixed reservation uplift (estimated +20% infra fee).

Option C — Aggressive commit (deeper discount, longer term):
- 12–24 month commit, blended target ~$550 per 1M at forecasted volumes; requires legal approved MA and upfront quarterlies.

Proposed next steps:
1) Karthik to send Option B as the recommended path to match their $750–$900 target (we’ll price the dedicated route uplift separately).
2) Attach blended-pricing-v1.pdf + draft MA/SOW and a short note describing routing/dedicated pool tradeoffs.
3) Schedule Tue 6/29 9:30am PT with IoTech (confirmed by Susan).

Attached: blended-pricing-v1.pdf (commercial narrative and band math).

Marissa
Head of Sales, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Susan — attaching the recommended commercial (Option B) per Marissa’s draft. Highlights:
- 12-month stepped commit; month-based step-ups mapped to your feature go-lives.
- Blended example at 150M tokens/month = $700 per 1M tokens (meets your target).
- Dedicated low-latency route available as a reserved pool with a +20% infra uplift; we’ll include a simple SLA for p95 latency during reserved windows.
- Term: 12 months with optional renewal cadence; billing monthly against committed bands.

Attachments: blended-pricing-v1.pdf, iot-ma-poc-sow.docx
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/s/abcdef123456 (will send commercial + MA for signature once we have verbal agreement)

Thanks — see you Tue 9:30am PT.
